evidence: The coated materials were analyzed using weight-gain measurements, nitrogen adsorption surface-area analysis, energy dispersive X-ray analysis, and scanning electron microscopy. In addition, the individual ALD surface reactions on the silica gel powder were monitored in situ using quadrupole mass spectrometry. Cross-sectional energy dispersive X-ray analysis (EDAX) was utilized to study the infiltration of the silica gel at various stages of the Al2O3 ALD. We used these measurements to identify the rate-limiting factor governing Al2O3 ALD in silica gel. We also employed in situ quadrupole mass spectrometry (QMS) to monitor the nucleation and growth of the ALD Al2O3 on the silica gel surface.
